_comment: Copy to config/business-profile.json and edit. This is what every agent is told about your business. Nothing here ships with the pack — it is yours.
what_we_do: weekly vehicle rentals for rideshare drivers
_rate_card_comment: The ONLY prices the agents may quote. lib/claims.js REFUSES any price or percentage in a draft that is not here — including at dry-run. Leave it empty and the agents cannot quote at all; they will say they'll check and come back, which is the safe default.
_industry_pack_comment: Optional. A FORGE pack name (auto_detail, med_spa, real_estate, credit_funding, …). Switches on that vertical's claim rules — e.g. med_spa blocks cure/permanence claims and named treatments, real_estate blocks fair-housing coded language.
notes: We never quote a price that is not on the current rate card.
Deposits are always confirmed by a human before pickup.
